decisions.reason: The revised Payment and Milestone Schedule table does not change the biography count, source, affiliation, or population method.
The source revises the structure of a specific table but does not change the requirement to include all required RFQ content or resolve the Section 11 ambiguity.
The Payment and Milestone Schedule revision does not affect inclusion or placement of the organization chart.
Adding rows to or replacing one table does not change the fixed order of the RFQ sections.
The table revision does not alter the approved white background treatment for the identified special pages.

Although the revised table must be accommodated within the document, the source does not change the existing full-document layout approach or spacing requirements; the table-specific effect is already owned by the source Requirement.
The revised table structure does not change the Blue Mesa Strategies identity, logo, or color requirements.
The table revision does not change the required PDF format, count, export quality, or email-submission constraints.
The source does not change Canva editing access, ownership, or the free-asset policy.
The Payment and Milestone Schedule revision does not affect photo selection, placement, relocation, or framing.
The source changes the table's row structure but establishes no new font, sizing, or bolding rule.
The table revision does not change the requirement that proposal hyperlinks remain functional.
